rows.actual: Can the R-147 rank-one past/current active-spectator realization be inserted unchanged into two nonzero blocks of the R-146 canonical covariance chart?
rows.name: EXP-000625 question

rows.actual: The radial covariance determinant is 250(100a+13)/(25000a^3+10000a^2+1115a+24)>0. Every nonzero canonical block has rank two, while the exact R-147 line-supporting past and current blocks have rank one. The unchanged line is therefore not a two-nonzero-block R-146 proportional-covariance chart.
rows.name: EXP-000625 finding

rows.actual: This does not obstruct construction of a new full-rank canonical Brownian chart. Such a chart leaves the exact R-147 line and must recompute the complete owner.
rows.name: EXP-000625 boundary

rows.actual: Choose either a new full-rank canonical reconstruction or the registered old-chart direct route before evaluating companions.
rows.name: EXP-000625 next_action

rows.actual: If the exact R-147 line is realized in a declared noncanonical last-root Gaussian coefficient chart, does its shared-probe trace match the centered Doob bracket?
rows.name: EXP-000626 question

rows.actual: The exact mismatch is delta=bar_tau-beta=-sigma^4 E f''(sigma g)+sigma^4||E A'(sigma g)||^2. Above the R-147 adverse threshold f''(0)<0, so delta>0 for all sufficiently small sigma. Direct 48/80/112 and independent 32/64/96 Gauss-Hermite checks agree at the registered fixture.
rows.name: EXP-000626 finding

rows.actual: The chart is not the R-146 proportional-covariance chart and does not transport R-063/R-104/R-125 owners. Positive mismatch is not a complete-action or phase counterexample.
rows.name: EXP-000626 boundary

rows.actual: In any proposed production chart, derive bar_tau and beta from the actual full-rank current and reject the chart if matching fails.
rows.name: EXP-000626 next_action

rows.actual: Does the negative R-147 coefficient curvature f''(0) prove a negative relative Hessian under a deterministic active-spectator control shift?
rows.name: EXP-000627 question

rows.actual: The control gradient is sigma^4 E f'''/2 and the Hessian is sigma^4 E f^(4)/2. Here f'''(0)<0, while f^(4)(0)>0 above r4=-3/14+3sqrt(11)/28. Since r4<1/7<1/3<r147, every R-147 adverse point has positive small-noise owner Hessian but negative small-noise gradient.
rows.name: EXP-000627 finding

rows.actual: Positive curvature does not prove stationarity or a local minimum. The calculation is a minimal coefficient diagnostic, not the complete production action.
rows.name: EXP-000627 boundary

rows.actual: Always report the first derivative together with the Hessian and impose the full production stationarity equation before any stability claim.
rows.name: EXP-000627 next_action

rows.actual: What is the exact relative action after adding the normalized source and terminal sextic once to the last-root coefficient diagnostic?
rows.name: EXP-000628 question

rows.actual: The exact action is equation (6.4) of R-148. Its Hessian is 9kappa/10+sigma^4 E f^(4)(sigma g)/2+36(R^4+6R^2 sigma^2+15sigma^4)/5, positive at every R-147 adverse point for sufficiently small sigma. Its gradient is sigma^4 E f'''(sigma g)/2<0, so the origin is not stationary.
rows.name: EXP-000628 finding

rows.actual: Future, forest, balanced, returned-low, and spatial production terms are not proved zero. No global-sigma sign, minimizer, or phase conclusion follows.
rows.name: EXP-000628 boundary

rows.actual: Recompute the same gradient and Hessian in one owner-complete production chart, then test the global relative bound rather than this local toy curvature.
rows.name: EXP-000628 next_action

rows.actual: Can the full cross-reveal Gram, forest jets, low response, and spatial Hessian be reconstructed from the exact diagonal coefficient energy f(q)?
rows.name: EXP-000629 question

rows.actual: The rotated and unrotated features have identical norm one for every q, but their q=0 to q=1 mixed Grams are zero and one and their derivative energies at zero are four and zero. Therefore f(q) does not identify the cross-Gram or jet data, much less the forest, future, balanced, low, and spatial owners.
rows.name: EXP-000629 finding

rows.actual: Nonidentifiability does not prove that no complete lift exists. It requires the missing synthesis, covariance incidence, filtration, projector, feedback, forest, future, low, and spatial data to be supplied.
rows.name: EXP-000629 boundary

rows.actual: Register a complete chart tuple before any further owner sign computation; otherwise record the route as underdetermined.
rows.name: EXP-000629 next_action

rows.actual: Does the R-148 covariance-rank argument force both the adapted past and the fresh R-147 line increments to be rank one?
rows.name: EXP-000630 question

rows.actual: Only the fresh final scalar innovation is necessarily supported on span(1,-1), hence rank one. This already contradicts every nonzero R-146 proportional final block, whose active-spectator covariance has rank two. An adapted past may contain later corrections, so no past-rank-one necessity is proved.
rows.name: EXP-000630 finding

rows.actual: The correction does not permit the unchanged fresh line in the canonical chart, and it does not obstruct a new full-rank chart or determine any phase.
rows.name: EXP-000630 boundary

rows.actual: Use only the fresh-final-block obstruction in R-148; any claim about past rank must declare a no-correction fixture or prove an adapted-correction theorem.
rows.name: EXP-000630 next_action

rows.actual: Do the R-148 m-derivatives identify the physical deterministic-control Hessian of the production action?
rows.name: EXP-000631 question

rows.actual: The registered formulas differentiate only a coefficient-background parameter while holding the current prefactor sigma g fixed. A physical lift that also shifts the current gains additional m sigma^2 E f' and m^2 E f/2 terms. Therefore no physical control Hessian is identified. The proved signs are pointwise at each fixed adverse point; the gradient is nonzero with sign minus sign(R), and the source curvature 9kappa/10 is only nonnegative when kappa may vanish.
rows.name: EXP-000631 finding

rows.actual: The coefficient-parameter diagnostic remains exact and phase-neutral. It proves neither stability nor instability of the complete action and supplies no uniform noise threshold at the adverse boundary.
rows.name: EXP-000631 boundary

rows.actual: Specify a physical synthesis and source lift before computing the production gradient or Hessian; report first derivative, stationarity, and curvature together.
rows.name: EXP-000631 next_action

no_overclaim: R-148 is a fixed-cutoff, fixed-floor fresh-final-block rank obstruction and a separately declared last-root coefficient diagnostic. It excludes only inserting the exact rank-one fresh R-147 innovation unchanged as a nonzero R-146 proportional-covariance final block; it proves no rank-one necessity for an adapted past and does not obstruct a new full-rank canonical owner system. The toy mismatch and coefficient-background parameter formulas do not transport the registered R-063/R-104/R-125 multi-root production owners or identify a physical deterministic-control Hessian. The small-noise conclusions are pointwise at each fixed adverse parameter, not uniform up to the threshold. Positive parameter curvature does not prove stationarity, stability, or a phase. No complete owner sign, global-noise bound, T-050 or A13 closure, Nelson theorem, removal, interacting measure, BCC preference or exclusion, PDE replacement, or Sector-A closure follows.
